comments.body:
Thanks, Alex. Tested this locally on top of today's main and the fallback works well.

One thing came up in CI: the latest OpenAI SDK (3.48) depends on httpx2 instead of httpx, so the new test file couldn't import httpx and pytest stopped before running anything. I pushed a small commit to your branch that builds the fake 400 response the same way our other OpenAI tests do, so the test no longer needs httpx. All 8 tests still pass, and CI is green.
